en: Linux: Fixed sandboxed Bash commands failing with `bwrap: Can't create file` when a `--plugin-dir` folder was also an added directory and `permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories` was on
zh: Linux：修复了当 `--plugin-dir` 文件夹同时是已添加的目录且启用了 `permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories` 时，沙箱化 Bash 命令因 `bwrap: Can't create file` 而失败的问题
